name: Mizusawa Ann
source: The protagonist's childhood friend. Despite the fact that she is older than Niina, they have the same loli physical appearances, at a glance its impossible to tell who is older. Despite the fact that she loves the protagonist, because of her tsundere personality she keeps those feelings hidden. She pretends to be knowledgeable about sex, but in fact have zero experience and know next to nothing about it.
